title.native: 夜桜四重奏 ～ヨザクラカルテット～

synonyms: Quartet of Cherry Blossoms in the Night
description:
When demons walk the streets, the cops need to recruit more demons!

In a town where humans and demons co-exist, it takes more than a normal police force to maintain the peace. Enter the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office, a fantastic foursome of unique teenagers, each gifted with an amazing super power! Since it sometimes takes real demon-fire to fight demon fire, the first three quarters of the team aren't exactly human: Ao, a cat-eared telepath; Kotoha, a half-human conjuror; and Hime, descended from a dragon (and the town's acting mayor), all of whom also happen to be delightfully female.

Rounding out the group is the token male and human, Akina, the office director and "Oyakume," capable of banishing spirits permanently (and from their point of view quite fatally) via a process called tuning. They may not look as impressive as some other superhero teams, and they certainly don't have the most dynamic name ever, but come hell hounds or high water, but they will defend their city!

(Source: RightStuf)

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Occupation:__ Oyakume

Akina Hiizumi is the director of the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office and the successor of the Hiizumi Clan. 

He is usually cheerful, light-spirited, kind and cordial to people around him, and diplomatic and polite in stressful situations. His kind approach to people although might be natural, seems also to derive from a structured ethical intelligence, that he urges to build up. In spite of being oblivious to girls who have crushes on him, he is very observant when a friend is in need and will approach them in a light and encouraging mood. When a crucial moment comes, he is not afraid to speak his mind even angrily to demand justice and to defend his friends, and so he is courageous.

~!Many of his and the townsfolk memories regarding Hime and her true nature were sealed away and when their memories finally came back he remembered that Hime was a demon and he was the one who knitted her the scarf she wears everywhere to hide her neck scar. Despite being able to use tuning, it was revealed by Enjin that somewhere deep within Akina lies the power to use Falling too, just like Enjin has the power to use Tuning.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 161 cm
__Occupation:__ Mayor

Hime Yarizakura is the mayor of Sakurashin Town and works together with the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office. She is the main protagonist of the series.

Most of Hime beliefs stem from her grandmothers teachings. Hime is very devoted to her town and the people that inhabit it and goes to great efforts to ensure that the citizens enjoy living in Sakurashin Town. She is very kind and forgiving, allowing many of her previous enemies to live in the town and refrains from killing. Hime will often put the needs of the town and its citizens before the needs of her own. At times Hime can behave childish, crying for food and being too stubborn to backdown from her position. Despite this, Hime does acknowledge the mistakes she makes and does her best to resolve them.

~! After becoming the mayor at the age of nine she asked Yae to seal the memories of the townspeople about her being a demon, so that she could view situations from both human and demon perspectives, because of this request Akina also forgot about her true nature and about the scarf that he knitted for her when they were children to hide her neck scar that was the result of Yae sealing her demon powers away. Since the day Akina gave her the scarf she had a romantic interest in him and was even willing to kill Enjin when she believed he hurt Akina despite her "no killing" policy !~

__Height:__ 145 cm
__Affiliations:__ Hiizumi Life Counseling Office

Ao Nanami is a satori demon (a demon in Japanese folklore with the ability to read minds) and resident of the Sakurashin Town. She works at the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office and is the younger sister of [Gin Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/16718/).

While she is possibly the youngest member of the team, she is certainly one of the most caring and friendly ones. Ao is constantly seen to be the one who is always first to help a person in need and has a playful nature that encourages everyone around her and despite being a demon, even the human children love to play with her and she always finds an opportunity so spend time with them. 

~!Even being the cheerful heart of the team, Ao has her own internal struggles having to deal with her brother Gin currently being dead and his body taken over by [Enjin](https://anilist.co/character/16443/).!~

Ao seems to have some kind of romantic relationship with [Kotoha](https://anilist.co/character/14946/).

A sixteen-year-old high school student who was once a human before she was possessed by a youkai at a very young age. Because of that event, she became a Hanyou, half youkai, and half-human. She is a Language-user (Kotodama tsukai) who can summon things when she emphasizes words. She can conjure up weapons or objects by saying one word, however, there are certain objects where she needs to use a lengthy spell in order to conjure them up. She is also a gun nut. She is also known to be a great singer by her friends. The manga mentions that she is only interested in girls, which is noticeable in chapter ten when all the other characters except Gin attend the party. Even though she wears glasses, she has said they are just for decoration. When she's mad, she tends to go a bit overboard in her fights. It is also of note that if she overuses her power, she can lose her voice for a while.

__Height:__ 177 cm

An eighteen-year-old man who is an assistant to Hime Yarizakura. He is an oni with superhuman strength but wears a seal that looks like a bracelet around his left wrist. He appears to be harsh towards Akina sometimes because in the anime, as he believes that Akina's power is not required to protect the town. In the manga, he believes that the youkai in the human world are suffering because Akina did not succeed as oyakume. Akina makes fun of him by saying that Kyōsuke has a sister complex, which usually ends up with the two fightings.

__Height:__ 164 cm

A sixteen year old high school student who is Kyousuke's little sister. She is also an employee of Hiizumi Life Counseling. Just like her brother, she is a youkai with superhuman strength. She has a crush on Akina, which Kyousuke is not pleased with it. In the manga, unlike her brother, she can not completely control her strength even with a seal. In the anime, she appears to have better control over her strength.

The main antagonist. A youkai who somehow is determined to destroy the barrier protecting the city for unknown reasons. Later is revealed that he has no phisical body and is infact possessing the body of Gin who happens to be Ao's older brother, a wolf-youkai who was best friends with Hime and Akina.

He appears as a young boy, however he is really much older; He has been watching over Sakurashin for over 200 years and is the District Mayor. In episode 7 of the anime, he claims he fancies Rin. He seems to be something of a womanizer, as in the same episode, he is told on many occasions that he is only to look at the women of the festival by Mariabelle and Yae. His hobby is making Mariabelle cosplay for him.

The District Mayor's assistant, which makes her Yuhi's assistant. Yuhi's power as a god is rooted to her.  She is usually seen in some sort of cosplay outfit. She likes to eat Japanese food for breakfast and if she does not get Japanese food for breakfast, she gets mad.
Gin Nanami is Ao's older brother and possesses the same powers as her. He was possessed by Enjin Hiizumi.

__Height:__ 148 cm

She is a Jiang Shi, a Chinese type of zombie that absorbs energy from the living ones. She used to be afraid of the townspeople, but actually she is cheerful and hardworking, caring about the others.

A doctor who runs a clinic in Sakurashin. Akina comes by to her clinic to get himself check over because of his tuning ability. She has her own TV show called the Juli Channel. She's a 100% human and train herself which results in having superhuman strength. Juli used to be an assistant for Hime when Hime was a child and had finally become mayor of Sakurashin.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Yuhi's younger sister. She is actually a land goddess created by Yuhi himself. She is usually dressed as a nun and wields two katanas. She can easily cut a car in half using a technique called Spring Wind (名東風 Haru Kaze). She appears to be fond of bear plush toys and even wearing a bear costume helmet given by Hime to stop a robbery. As a land goddess she is pretty much invulnerable in a fight, but she is susceptible to clothing damage. Despite being incredibly powerful, she is forbidden by Yuhi to interfere with the conflicts in the town because of her role as land goddess, although she has defied that order on multiple occasions.
